extraction.Name: Julia Mengal, formerly Julia Ramis, Jr.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 22, 1921, by Julia Mengal
extraction.Buyer: conveyed the land to Lloyd Mengal, husband, for $1.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739698 issued; receipt for the patent was signed March 12, 1921, by the allottee; conveyance dated March 21, 1921; land described as Southeast quarter, section 14, township 95, north of range 76; husband listed as Lloyd Mengal; allottee described as wife, farmer
